title: policy.json: orchestrator
description: The orchestrator session itself: when it hands over to a fresh one (design parts 5.4 and 13.1).

handover_context_share.description: The share of its context window the orchestrator may use before it checkpoints and hands over to a fresh session. The chief of staff measures it from the harness's record of the session at each wake and check-in and records it with hitld run context; past it, hitld dispatch start refuses with handover-due.

handover_after_completions.description: How many completions an orchestrator session processes before it hands over to a fresh session, whatever its context says. Short-lived sessions keep each context small.

silent_after_seconds.description: How long an orchestrator started by a chief of staff may stay quiet, after a wake or recorded work, with no message reaching the chief of staff, before hitld dispatch watch reports it as silent: its turn ended without the end-of-turn message.

escalate_after_wakes.description: How many wakes the chief of staff may send a silent orchestrator, counted since the last message that reached it, before hitld dispatch watch sets escalate_to_owner and the chief of staff tells the owner.
